name: YU
description: Yala Protocol allows users to lock Bitcoin as collateral to mint YU stablecoins. YU serves as both an asset and a tool, connecting Bitcoin with any ecosystem. Users can borrow, earn interest, and gain seamless access to DeFi applications across multiple chains.
mintRedeemDescription: Users mint YU by depositing Bitcoin as collateral assets into the Yala Protocol. When the loan is repaid to retrieve the collateral, the paid back YU is burned.
